entries.title: Deposited crambin: 1CRN
entries.description: Three prepared representations of the same deposited protein: atomic sticks, residue beads and a schematic envelope.
entries.provenance: Pinned RCSB PDB/CCD CC0 inputs, source lock and shared-coordinate packages in animlib fixtures.
limitations: A static deposited conformer does not supply a folding trajectory.
The envelope is schematic; CA beads are residues, not atoms.

applicableClaims: Exact pinned 1CRN deposited coordinates in the selected atomic, residue or schematic envelope representation.
excludedClaims: Measured molecular dynamics or folding trajectories.
Atomic contacts from backbone anchors; reconstructed missing residues or biological assemblies.
requiredInputs: Exact asset or PDB accession, selected chains and source identity.
Explicit representation and scientific question; pivot and supplied or illustrative keyframes for motion.
reuseContract.preparationRoute: Use the existing exact 1CRN fixture publication route and its source lock; generic PDB preparation is a distinct selected representation.
motionLimitations: s.rigidMotion supplies a seekable rigid pose, not molecular deformation or a dynamics solver.
Label authored transforms illustrative; supplied transforms retain their source and do not alone prove dynamics.
fallbackComposition: Research and prepare the exact required structure when identity or representation differs.
Compose annotated schematic primitives for unsupported claims with explicit schematic labels; never silently substitute an asset.

entries.title: RCSB deposited molecular structures
entries.description: Research and publish a selected protein or nucleic structure through the existing PDB preparation path.
entries.provenance: Host downloads fixed RCSB PDB/CCD endpoints and records hash-checked cached snapshots and source selections.
limitations: Requires a researched supported four-character PDB accession and available publication tool.
Returned protein traces and nucleotide geometry do not reconstruct assemblies, dynamics, or missing atoms.

entries.title: Illustrative peptide rig and staging
entries.description: Original component templates, stable residue identities and prescribed torsions for staged coil formation and packing.
entries.provenance: Original CC0-1.0 sequence and staging; component geometry derives from pinned CC0 CCD inputs.
limitations: Authored motion is neither a measured folding trajectory nor an energy simulation.
Packing has no general collision-avoidance guarantee.

applicableClaims: Explicitly authored peptide torsion staging and stable residue identity.
excludedClaims: Measured molecular dynamics or folding trajectories.
Atomic contacts from backbone anchors; reconstructed missing residues or biological assemblies.
requiredInputs: Explicit amino-acid sequence, stable residue IDs and pinned CCD component inputs.
Absolute-time torsion samples and held stages; selected rig and staging source/recipe provenance.
reuseContract.preparationRoute: Use the existing peptide host builders with explicit sequence, pinned CCD inputs and prescribed torsions.
motionLimitations: s.peptidePose reconstructs linked geometry from prescribed torsions; Cartesian endpoint interpolation does not preserve bond lengths.
Terminal chemistry, side-chain frames and carbonyl construction are schematic; no solvent, energetic dynamics or general clash solution.
fallbackComposition: Prepare a new explicit sequence and torsion schedule with the peptide builders when the bundled rig differs.
Use annotated schematic primitives for unsupported chemistry; verify links, held stages and reverse seeking.

entries.title: Nucleic mechanism inputs
entries.description: Portable explicit sequence, pairing and schedule inputs for transcription and RNA processing examples.
entries.provenance: Versioned original illustrative inputs and preparation records bundled with animlib demonstrations.
limitations: Illustrative sequences and kinematic schedules are not deposited reaction measurements.
Scene VM cannot fetch these files; the host must prepare the selected input.

applicableClaims: Illustrative nucleic sequence, pairing and prescribed mechanism schedule.
excludedClaims: Measured molecular dynamics or folding trajectories.
Atomic contacts from backbone anchors; reconstructed missing residues or biological assemblies.
requiredInputs: Explicit nucleotide sequence, stable nucleotide IDs, antiparallel strand directions and complementary pairing.
Selected mechanism and absolute-time event schedule with mechanism-specific parameters, source/recipe provenance and required path/aperture inputs.
reuseContract.preparationRoute: Prepare explicit sequence, pairing and schedule through existing nucleic builders.
motionLimitations: Returned states, anchors and bonds provide schematic kinematics, not reaction dynamics or a general collision solver; translation does not predict protein folding.
Derive geometry from returned connectivity; verify incorporation, cut/join, transfer, stop/release boundaries, bounded clearance and deterministic reverse seeking.
fallbackComposition: Prepare a new explicit sequence, pairing and schedule through the chosen transcription, processing or translation builder.
Use annotated schematic primitives for unsupported mechanisms and separate exact-source evidence for stronger chemistry claims.

entries.title: Prepared native geometry and image packages
entries.description: Reusable immutable model/image packages with content hashes, provenance and explicit resource ownership.
entries.provenance: Package manifests retain original or upstream provenance, source hashes and binary dependency identities.
limitations: Native package registry and production GLB publication are distinct delivery paths.
Only explicitly selected assets and their dependencies should be loaded.
